title: Continue or Fold? White Room - Talk to an Embodied Digital Being
author: jin_sprited
selftext:
I'm trying to see if I can bring an AI character to life inside a website. Right now I am just using AI-generated character, but I would like to make it more rich in the future using hand drawn characters.

It is similar in concept with Neurosama. Personally I would love to integrate memory system and make it more like a living being that remembers connect with people.  

  
However, I have 2 other project's I'm working on (Lunamachi - cozy vibe room, Machi - virtual living environment for AI), and I want to see if working on this instead of those would be worth my time.
